posts.title: How Millcreek Canyon Will Change
posts.description: Construction started in Millcreek Canyon on May 1, 2025. The construction teams only work during the summer months, with the canyon reopening to the public for use during the winter. Since the start of construction, I've been documenting the upper canyon, from the gate to Elbow Fork, the day before it closes to the public each year. posts.title: The Design of Pit Toilets
posts.description: If you spend any amount of time hiking, biking or enjoying other outdoor activities, you’ll find one thing in common with most popular trailheads: a pit toilet. While pit toilets seem designed for humans, as I see it, the problem they aim to solve isn’t for us per se.
